quests.title: Give It Up!

dialogue.section: Go to Chinju Forest

dialogue.t: We've arrived. Alright, I will go to the Yashiro Commission now to inquire about Sayu's mission orders. In the meantime, please keep an eye on her.
Sayu, you can start by warming up. Though you may often be difficult for me, I certainly will not abide any trouble for the Traveler. Understand?
Yes, ma'am.
Good, she's gone. Phew, no more work for today, hehe!

dialogue.sit: So that's why you wanted me to come along? To help you slack off?

dialogue.t: Actually... I invited you to come as a helper. No need to go into too much detail.
The shrine maiden is terrifying. As soon as she picks up on my tracks, it's nearly impossible for me to shake her.
But you are also super skilled, so maybe you can help me.

dialogue.sit: I don't think I should be doing this kind of thing.

dialogue.t: Huh? You mean you won't rescue someone in a moment of dire need?
All that goes on here is cruel and involuntary labor.
Is it wrong to wish for ample rest? How else can I ever reach my growth spurt!? I'm not being unreasonable.

dialogue.sit: I've been meaning to ask you... Why are you so obsessed with sleeping all the time?

dialogue.t: Don't you know, there are tons of benefits to sleeping! You can regain energy, clear your mind, pass the time, and escape from all your troubles.
But most importantly, sleep helps you grow, and I've got plenty of growing to do.

dialogue.sit: Growing?

dialogue.t: That's right. The other ninja can leap up tall trees in a single bound and pick the tasty fruit way up high. Being tall is the key to everything.
All the other ninja my age are already way taller than me. Sensei told me that kids only have one chance to grow up, and that I'll miss my chance if I keep slacking off.

dialogue.sit: But is growing taller really related to how long you sleep?

dialogue.t: Of course it is! Haven't you seen someone suddenly grow taller while they're sleeping?

dialogue.sit: I've never seen anyone grow in their sleep.
I don't think anyone could "suddenly" grow taller.

dialogue.t: It happens all the time! Though, I guess it does sound silly when you think about it...
Ugh, never mind. The longer I talk to you, the more you'll convince me otherwise...
Besides, what's wrong with wanting a little more sleep? *yawn* See... I'm already crazy tired.

dialogue.sit: I can see that you're tired, but it's not good to neglect your work either.

dialogue.t: Exactly. At first, I only wanted to grow as fast as possible. But as I started sleeping more every day, the sleepier I became. The sleepier I became, the more I slept.
Even right now, I'm awake and talking with you, but my brain still feels half asleep... Trust me, work is the last thing on my mind.
Maybe you can help me! Even though I've been getting more sleep recently, I haven't gained any height at all. Any ideas?

dialogue.sit: It's not the amount of sleep but the quality of sleep that's keeping you from growing.

dialogue.t: Huh? You're saying there's a way to grow taller while I'm awake, too?

dialogue.sit: Plants grow best when the environmental conditions are right for them to generate energy and get proper nutrition. The same is probably true for people.

dialogue.t: Yes... You do have a point. Hmm.

dialogue.sit: How is your appetite these days?

dialogue.t: It's nothing compared to the adults. Just a little food is enough to make me full. I usually prefer eating fruit rather than those big, filling dishes.
But I think I get it now... With more nutrients, people can grow bigger and taller. If anybody can eat a lot, it's the samurai. I should follow their example.

dialogue.sit: You don't need to grow as big as a samurai though...

dialogue.t: Hehe, I guess. Let's head into town and find something to eat.

dialogue.sit: But Kano Nana hasn't returned yet.

dialogue.t: We won't be able to go anywhere once she's around. Now's our only chance!
Quality sleep is hard to come by, especially with the shrine maiden always after me... Not much I can do about that.
Somehow, she knows all my favorite napping spots. Sometimes I wonder if she knows everything. *sigh* It's tough to throw her off my trail.
Anyway, let's go have a look around. *yawn* Maybe we can find a nice place to curl up for a nap.
Yeah, I suppose I haven't kept up with my duties... I'm sorry, but...
*yawn* I really am getting sleepy...

dialogue.sit: It seems you aren't taking the matter to heart at all.

dialogue.t: It's because my work is just too boring. Transporting documents, organizing the ninja tools... As long as I don't do the work, no one will come asking me to do it again.
The higher ups always give all the important tasks to more suitable operatives. They never even give me a second thought.

dialogue.sit: It's still your responsibility to fulfil your duties.
You should try to at least keep your sensei and Kano Nana from worrying.

dialogue.t: Hmm. Now that you say that, I just had an idea.
If you learn ninjutsu and help me with my tasks, then I can sleep peacefully and focus more on growing.

dialogue.sit: You still haven't taken anything I've said to heart.

dialogue.t: Ninjutsu will come in super handy during your adventures. Don't worry, I'll personally teach you everything.
If you work hard, then I'll work hard to teach you. See? This way, nobody is wasting time being lazy, hehe!

dialogue.sit: Now you're the one trying to convince me to work.
Fine, if that's what we have to do.

dialogue.t: Thank you so much! See, you're the hero that protects Sayu's nap time!
We can start training as soon as the shrine maiden gets back.
Oh, I'm honestly surprised to see you still here, Sayu. Unless... Is this some sort of trick?
The Traveler is interested in ninjutsu and wants to learn together.
Is that so? Though it is strictly forbidden for some techniques to be taught to outsiders...
But I suppose you are an exception in this case.

dialogue.sit: Did you find out more about the ambush thing?

dialogue.t: Indeed, I did. I was able to determine that the Yashiro Commission had no intent of carrying out such a mission. They are now investigating the origins of these orders.
Rest assured, the related personnel are all aware of the situation and there should be no further threats to your safety.

dialogue.sit: Good to hear.

dialogue.t: Well then, let us begin your ninjutsu training.
Please, {NICKNAME}, follow us.

quests.description: Sayu has been discovered by Kano Nana, and has no choice but to return to Chinju Forest to practice ninjutsu. She begs you to come along, and so you do...

quests.title: A Mysterious Order

dialogue.section: Go to the city

dialogue.sit: (Huh?)
(Was that... Sayu? What's she doing running around here?)
(Let's go follow her, maybe we can find out what's going on.)

dialogue.section: Give chase in the direction of Sayu's disappearance

dialogue.sit: (She's nowhere to be seen...)
(We saw her only a moment ago, she couldn't have gone too far off.)
(Perhaps she's using her ninjutsu skills to hide. Hmm, let's have a look around the area.)

dialogue.section: Talk to Sayu

dialogue.t: Aw, you saw right through my disguise...
Odd... Even the shrine maiden often struggles to find me.

dialogue.sit: Well, if your tail wasn't sticking out...

dialogue.t: Huh? My tail was sticking out!?
*sigh* I must have been too nervous and failed to fully utilize my ninjutsu technique.
So, uh, what do you need?

dialogue.sit: I was about to ask you the same thing.
Weren't you looking for me just now?

dialogue.t: Well, uh... I heard that Shimura's added a delicious new dish to their menu.
And Yae Publishing House has some good light novels... Oh, and a dip in Aisa Bathhouse is always nice.
So uh, you know...
Today's weather is perfect for... all that stuff.
...So, what can I do for you?

dialogue.sit: ...What's the real reason?

dialogue.t: No really, I'm not up to anything. I'm just a little tired and thought I could use a good nap.
I'll be going now. Don't bother chasing me again, you won't be able to catch me anyway.

dialogue.sit: I suppose I'll just have a chat with the shrine maiden, then.
Perhaps I'll tell Kamisato Ayaka that I ran into you here.

dialogue.t: Oh no, anything but that!
*sigh* You're just as difficult as the shrine maiden. C'mon just let me go, would you.

dialogue.sit: Then I expect you to answer honestly.

dialogue.t: Oh, fine. But if I tell you the truth, I don't wanna hear any complaints, no matter how crazy the truth may seem.
So you know I'm in the Shuumatsuban, right? Well, it's our job to take care of matters that are "inconvenient" to the higher-ups.
Which sometimes includes ambushing people.

dialogue.sit: I see. Go on...
Ambushing, huh? That's sticky business.

dialogue.t: Huh? Doesn't that intimidate you even a little bit?
You do know what that means, right? And still no reaction, huh? Don't tell me it's because of my height.
Anyway, being ambushed is pretty scary. You should at least try to express a little concern.

dialogue.sit: But I'm not your target, right?

dialogue.t: Uh actually, according to my orders, you are... Though I have no intention of really attacking you.
I don't get it, they never assign me this kind of mission. There's loads of other suitable operatives.
All this craziness is starting to interfere with my sleep schedule. I just dropped by to see how you were doing. I was glad to see that you're okay.

dialogue.sit: But why all the running? And what's with all those lame excuses just now?

dialogue.t: I was worried about how you'd react...
I mean, who knows what you'd do if you knew that I was out to ambush you.
Yet, when I told you, you didn't so much as flinch. I guess that actually made me feel a lot better.

dialogue.sit: Well, you were a great help to us before. What's really concerning is whatever's behind these orders of yours.
I want to ask around and get to the bottom of this.

dialogue.t: Who do you want to talk to? Someone in the Yashiro Commission?

dialogue.sit: Who is the "shrine maiden" you mentioned earlier?

dialogue.t: She's the one who's been assigned to supervise my work. She always tries to catch me whenever I'm slacking off. Basically, it's her duty to keep me from napping.
But... she would probably know more about the origins of my mission.

dialogue.sit: Then let's go ask her about it.

dialogue.t: Fine... I'll take you to her, but I'll have to hide somewhere in the distance. If she catches me anywhere near there, I'll never hear the end of it.
And then they'll sentence me to all kinds of work, which'll really cut into my time for napping.

dialogue.sit: Don't worry, I understand. Let's go.

dialogue.t: Please, she's quite perceptive. You mustn't tell her that you've seen me anywhere.
You got that? We have a deal, no word about me.

dialogue.section: Ask the shrine maiden about the situation

dialogue.t: *sigh* Where has she run off to this time...
Hm? I didn't expect to see you here. You're {NICKNAME}, right? It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.sit: Do you know me?
Oh, you've heard of me?

dialogue.t: Yes, Miss Kamisato has spoken of you before. You seemed familiar. It appears my intuitions were correct.
May I ask what brings you here?

dialogue.sit: I happened to be in the area. Do you come here often?
It seems you are looking for something.

dialogue.t: It just so happens I'm looking for a little child by the name of Sayu.
She's a ninja with a nasty habit of disappearing the moment I turn around. *sigh* She's always neglectful of her duties.
She often comes here to take a nap, but it seems she's already predicted that I would come looking for her.
You haven't happened to see her anywhere, have you? She's wearing a mujina costume, pretty hard to miss.

dialogue.sit: Uh, no... No, I haven't.
No.
No, of course not.

dialogue.t: Really?
Well then, I suppose I'll just have to keep searching for her.

dialogue.sit: By the way, I've caught word that the Yashiro Commission has supposedly dispatched someone to ambush me.

dialogue.t: Oh? How could that be?
How did you catch wind of this? Did you encounter the ninja tasked with the matter?

dialogue.sit: No, I've just... heard things.
I've just got an unusual feeling that someone's following me.
Someone informed me that this might be happening. I've been on my guard.

dialogue.t: Huh... Well, I'm sure there's no need to worry. You're probably just overthinking things.
After all, you have been of great service to the Yashiro Commission and many are thankful for your actions. How could anyone even consider dispatching a ninja to attack you?

dialogue.sit: Is it possible that a ninja could have gone rogue? You know, a ninja like Sayu...

dialogue.t: Like Sayu? You mean to say that this matter is related to Sayu?

dialogue.sit: No, not at all. I'm just making an example, that's all.

dialogue.t: There's absolutely no need to worry about Sayu. If anything, she's extremely loyal and would never act presumptuously.
Though she often neglects her duties as a ninja and seems to never heed instructions, she's certainly not one to go against our principles.
Given her age, such portentous tasks are not assigned to her.

dialogue.sit: (Of course Sayu wouldn't hurt me...)
(What a relief...)
(But doesn't that just make Sayu even more suspicious?)

dialogue.t: What's the matter? Are you still worried?
Alright, just to be sure, I shall personally inquire about this matter with the Yashiro Commission.
Though I am the shrine maiden, it is also part of my duties to take on work from the Shuumatsuban.

dialogue.sit: While you are making inquiries, I shall continue investigating on my own, just to be safe.

dialogue.t: I'll be sure to look into it. I'm curious myself what could be the cause of such absurd rumors.
My intuition tells me that Sayu's mischief might be behind this whole misunderstanding.
Are you completely certain that you haven't seen her around recently?

dialogue.sit: Yes, absolutely certain.
(Seems there's no fooling her...)

dialogue.t: Hmm...
Aha! Sayu, I can see you. Come out from there!

dialogue.sit: (Don't tell me she left her tail sticking out again!)

dialogue.t: Don't even think about trying to sneak away. Come over here, this instant!
Hmm, it does appear that Sayu has really been given a mission to ambush you... Which wasn't assigned by me, of course.
I apologize, {NICKNAME}. I'm afraid I did not treat this matter with due sincerity.
I shall take these orders back to the Yashiro Commission for further clarification.
Good... Well if there's nothing left for me to do then I'll be...
Ahem! Sayu!
Oh, uh, y—yes!
Where do you think you're off to? You have ninjutsu training to complete, so you shall return with me to Chinju Forest.
Yes, but you know, an exceptional ninja must not only work hard, but also have ample rest. *yawn* It happens to be time for my nap, so I'll see you next time... Goodbye and good night.
You're coming with me, even if I have to carry you, Sayu. Is that what you want?
Oh, n—no need. I'm sorry, I'll come quietly.
In which case... {NICKNAME}, will you come with us, too?

dialogue.sit: Why?

dialogue.t: I promise there won't be any trouble. I need a bit of your time, that's all.
I helped you by bringing you to the shrine maiden, so now you need to return the favor.

dialogue.sit: Alright, fine.
Good thing we didn't have any other plans.

dialogue.t: Ugh... I honestly hope you are not up to something again, Sayu.
Yes, of course. I'm sorry that this matter has taken up so much of your time. I'll be sure to look into it and get back to you as soon as possible.
Whew, that was close. Thanks for not ratting me out.

dialogue.sit: Good thing you didn't fall asleep.

dialogue.t: Hey, even I find it hard to sleep through a tense moment like that.

dialogue.sit: So we know that Kano Nana isn't behind your mission, is there anyone else you can think of?

dialogue.t: Hmm, I don't know where else to start...
Oh, but there is one official guy who is responsible for delivering orders from the Yashiro Commission to the Shuumatsuban. Anyone with missions like this will report directly to him.
But I never receive those kind of missions, so I've hardly ever spoken to him before.

dialogue.sit: That makes him a likely suspect.
Maybe there's a way we can get his attention?

dialogue.t: Oh, so what should I do?

dialogue.sit: Just pretend that you've already finished the job.

dialogue.t: Huh!? B—But, I can't do that... I mean, I—I can't even squish an Onikabuto, there's no way I...
Oh wait, you said pretend, didn't you? You almost scared my tail off... But even so, I'm a lousy liar...

dialogue.sit: Don't worry, I'll give you some hair and other evidence to report back with.

dialogue.t: Oh, I get it. We'll take the evidence, stuff it in a bag, and write my name on it. Then, all I need to do is put it in the big box used for reports and wait for him to see it. I'm sure he'll come looking for me.
*yawn* But that's a lot to do, and it's really far away.

dialogue.sit: Hey, you have to help me out here.

dialogue.t: Oh fine, I guess my nap will have to wait till later. Just stay put, okay? I'll be back in no time.
*panting* I finally made it back.
Your evidence caught his attention right away. He gave me a different location to meet him up later. Strange, why wouldn't we just meet at the Police Station?

dialogue.sit: Maybe he's up to something.
That's even more suspicious.

dialogue.t: Let's go to the meeting point, I want to settle this quickly so I can finally curl up for a nice, long nap.
(This appears to be just an ordinary pile of junk. Someone will likely come by to clean it up soon.)
(There doesn't seem to be anything of particular interest here, let's go have a look somewhere else.)
(Nope, she doesn't seem to be around here.)
(Hm? What's that strange-looking thing?)

quests.description: As you walk through Inazuma City, you feel a strange gaze from somewhere around you.

quests.title: Bottleneck Breaking

dialogue.section: Dine with Sayu

dialogue.t: *sniffs* Oh, something smells amazing here! It smells so good that I'd even wake up to find where it's coming from!
Welcome to Kiminami Restaurant! What can I get for the two of you?
Oh, hmm... Lemme think. I'll have Rice Cake Soup, a Tuna Sushi, a Tricolor Dango... Oh, and one Tri-Flavored Skewer, please.

dialogue.sit: Don't you think that's a bit much for you?

dialogue.t: Time waits for no one, it's time for me to take things into my own hands. If I can't grow more by eating more, then we'll still have time to try something else.

dialogue.sit: Makes sense.
It seems you've really put a lot of thought into this.

dialogue.t: I've always taken a proactive approach to growing taller. I can even overcome my sleepiness if I need to.
Speaking of which, I've never been able to eat very much in one sitting. I thought I could try and see what my limits are this time.
But... if I can't finish it all, would you help me...
Ugh, no! That's no good... I've got to stay positive, I know I can finish it all.

dialogue.sit: Don't worry, I'll help you finish whatever's left.

dialogue.t: Yay, thanks! That way, I don't have to worry about any of the food going to waste.
Eating food like this will help me grow right away, won't it? Maybe I'll gain a whole 6 inches!

dialogue.sit: Let's not get too optimistic, growing takes time.

dialogue.t: Yeah, you might be right. Let's eat everything up and find out.
*hiccup* Ugh...

dialogue.sit: Are you feeling okay?

dialogue.t: I'm alright... Don't worry about me...
I'm just a bit full, that's all... Ugh, I can't move.

dialogue.sit: Pretty sure that means you're not okay.

dialogue.t: Ugh, I don't feel like I'm getting taller at all. If anything, I'm only growing wider.
But if that's the price of getting taller, then I'm willing to pay it.
Okay... Time to order some more Dango.
Dango... Yes, more Dango...

dialogue.sit: Uh, are you okay?

dialogue.t: I think the Dango are making a swirl reaction in my tummy...
Urgh, who knew Dango could pack such a punch.

dialogue.sit: If you eat any more, I think you might burst.

dialogue.t: Ugh, I just don't get it...
Why does growing have to be so difficult!?

dialogue.sit: Eating like this might have a negative effect on your health. Maybe we should consider some other options.

dialogue.t: Let's keep at it. No pain, no gain!
But maybe I could try some other food... All the stuff we just ordered is starting a swirl reaction in my tummy.

dialogue.sit: Alright, then follow me.
We shouldn't bite more than we can chew.

dialogue.t: Yeah, I understand.
Remember, not too fast now... Oof, my tummy hurts!
But are there any other options? ...I never thought that eating could be so painful.

dialogue.sit: We could always try doing some training.

dialogue.t: Ugh, believe me, I already know everything there is about training.

dialogue.sit: Kids that love running and jumping everywhere give a strong impression that they are going to grow a lot.

dialogue.t: Hmm, you do have a point...
Now that I think about it, the tallest ninja in the Shuumatsuban always seems to be training their ninjutsu and accepting extremely difficult tasks.

dialogue.sit: Maybe sleep has only had the opposite effect on you.

dialogue.t: No, no, that can't be it... Actually, I haven't kept a good balance of sleep and training, but that's because I feel sleepy way more often than I feel energetic!
Hmm, I get it now. I need to do more training with you. Adventuring, combat — I need to do it all!

dialogue.sit: Why don't you come with me and see if the Adventurers' Guild has any commissions for us to handle?

dialogue.t: Pardon my eavesdropping, but did you say that you're going to the Adventurers' Guild to take a commission?

Recently, we've been running into a group of rowdy Treasure Hoarders whenever we go into the wild to gather ingredients. It seems as if they're intentionally targeting our restaurant staff. *sigh* I hope you can understand how dire the situation has become.
This matter has been taking a real toll on our business. Since I've already submitted the commission to Katheryne, perhaps you can consider helping us out?
Treasure Hoarders, huh? Well, bad guys are the best practice targets for ninjutsu.

dialogue.sit: Okay! We'll take care of it.
I guess our post-meal plans are settled then.

dialogue.t: Great, you have my thanks! Let me show you where the Treasure Hoarders have been most active these days.

dialogue.section: The battle is over, talk to Sayu

dialogue.t: Alright, last one. Watch this!
Oh no, aaaaaaah!
*whimpers*
How... How could this happen?

dialogue.sit: What's wrong?
Are you injured?

dialogue.t: No, it's all that big brute's fault. Just as I was taking care of the last of them, he charged straight at me!
I moved back to dodge him, but he was too tall... As he reached out to grab me, his hand landed right on my head.
It's over... It's all over. All that hard work for nothing. Ugh, he crossed the line... Everyone knows that if you're trying to grow taller, you can't be touched on the head.

dialogue.sit: You're saying getting patted on the head can stunt your growth?

dialogue.t: Of course! I never let anyone touch my head. Who knows how much I'll have to eat and sleep or how much training I'll have to do to make up for it.

dialogue.sit: I don't think that will stop you from growing.
You're just assuming things.

dialogue.t: Ugh, it's a real bummer, you know. *sigh* I see you're just trying to comfort me. Thanks...
It's not fun to be patted on the head. But what's done is done, there's nothing I can do about it now.
Uh, just forget it, I give up on growing. I'm not gonna grow any taller today, that's for sure.
Sorry, I don't want to bum you out with my terrible mood. I should probably just go back now. The shrine maiden's gonna give me a real earful, might as well get it over with.

dialogue.sit: There's a saying, you know: All good things come to those who wait.
It simply takes time to grow.

dialogue.t: I get it... I'll try to look at the bright side.
I was too anxious about growing and now I'm being punished by the archons.

dialogue.sit: I have another idea, Sayu.

dialogue.t: No, no need. I don't want to trouble you anymore. Maybe my stunted growth is tied to my bad attitude more than anything else.
Getting you involved any further will just be a waste of your time.

dialogue.sit: Though you might not be growing taller now, you can still experience the feeling of growing.

dialogue.t: Huh? "The feeling of growing"... What do you mean?

dialogue.sit: Imagine, after you grow taller, you can reach higher places and see much farther, right?

dialogue.t: Yeah, that's exactly what I'm after.

dialogue.sit: Alright then, come with me. I promise you'll feel better.

dialogue.t: Reach higher and see farther... really?
Sounds good, I appreciate all your help.

dialogue.section: Go to a high spot to relax with Sayu

dialogue.t: You had me worried on the way here, you know. I seriously wondered if you were taking me to the Kamisato residence or the shrine...
But you weren't kidding, I can see much farther from here.
Somehow I feel a little better after coming up so high.

dialogue.sit: Is there anything in particular that you'd like to do after you grow taller?

dialogue.t: No, nothing particularly special. I'd simply like to go to the forest and pick some fruit from the trees without having to jump or find something to step on. Just that would be enough to make me happy.
I'd also like to go swimming in water that's too deep for me now, and no one will tease me anymore for my toes not being able to touch the bottom.
Oh, oh! And I'll be able to eat more, too, and stop wasting food all the time.

dialogue.sit: I suppose being taller will make things easier for you.

dialogue.t: Oh! And not to mention I'll become more free, too!
I won't need to have a guardian to look after me, and the shrine maiden won't be out to catch me anymore.
I'll even be able to visit other places for training. I'll go wherever I want and sleep wherever I want!
Ah, imagine, no need to catch up on naps anymore. That will be the day...
By the way, do you happen to need anyone with ninjutsu skills to accompany you on your adventures?

dialogue.sit: Adventuring is a grueling experience.
Adventuring is not a game.

dialogue.t: Hm, see? You still see me by my current height. Hmph! Who knows, maybe I'll be even taller than you one day!
Just wait till I'm taller. You won't need to worry about me ever again, hehe.

dialogue.sit: See? You're already in a better mood.

dialogue.t: Yeah, you're right. Thanks.
From now on, I'll visit high places more often. They really do work miracles.

dialogue.sit: This isn't the highest you can achieve, you know.

dialogue.t: Huh? What do you mean?

dialogue.sit: You can still reach even higher and see even farther, but you can't do that just by standing here.

dialogue.t: Oh, I see. So what should I do?
Huh? Wh—Wh—Whoaaaa!

dialogue.section: Go to Shimura's

dialogue.t: Lesson learned... Next time, only order one dish. If we finish it, then we can order another...
That would be a better plan, wouldn't it?

dialogue.sit: It seems you've reached your limit. How about we take a break?

dialogue.t: No way, I won't give up. Some things can never be achieved until you push yourself.
If I can't eat any more, then we can always order some tea.
My body needs to get the signal that I'm trying to grow taller.

dialogue.sit: It can be hard to be nimble with a full stomach.

dialogue.t: Yeah, I'm a little worried about that, too...
Ninja must be quick on their feet. It'd be embarrassing to get stuck in a tight passageway.
But my body will feel my desire to grow and direct all the nutrients to the right place.

dialogue.sit: Uh, good luck with that.
I'm not sure if it'll be that easy.

dialogue.t: I've already eaten this much, I can't give up now!
Ugh, that's it, I'm done... Growing is more painful than I thought.
We still have two Radishes left over. Would you mind finishing them?

dialogue.sit: Sure thing. I've been waiting for a chance to help.

dialogue.t: No, wait a second. Let me think...
On second thought, let me try to eat more.
Otherwise, I'll feel like I didn't give it my best shot. I should at least eat one more.
Then, I'll call it quits. No more trying to grow by eating.
Whew, alright... Here it goes.
Sayu? Where are you, Sayu? Come out this instant!
Uh oh! It's the shrine maiden! Not good...

dialogue.sit: We've been out for too long.

dialogue.t: She's coming this way! What should we do!?
There's only one option now... I'll lead her away from here and try to shake her off my trail. We'll meet back here later.
I'll just slip away and... Ugh, oh no! My tummy... it's too full...
Whoa!

dialogue.section: Go to the Treasure Hoarders' camp

dialogue.t: Thanks again for offering your help. Please do be careful out there.
She did eat quite a lot, will she be okay?
You should keep an eye on her, just in case.
Anna was right, there's the Treasure Hoarders.
All that food we just ate is weighing me down a bit, but I think we can still handle them.

quests.description: You tell Sayu that she needs enough nutrition to grow tall. She follows you enthusiastically to Inazuma City...

quests.title: Sleep Alone Can't Wait

dialogue.section: Go to Sayu's sleeping spot

dialogue.t: Time to put our ninjutsu to good use!

dialogue.section: Go to the backup nap location

dialogue.t: Hmm, seems like the coast is clear.
Huh? Wait, what's that?

dialogue.sit: It looks like some sort of sharp, pointy ninja gadget...

dialogue.t: Oh, now I recognize it. It's meant to keep intruders at bay, but is also often used for ninja training. It really hurts if you step on one, so be careful.
There's a bunch on the stones here, and probably some in the grass as well... I see traces of lots of activity here. I've got a bad feeling about this.

dialogue.sit: What's wrong?

dialogue.t: It's one of the shrine maiden's tactics. Once she discovers one of my napping spots, she'll turn it into a training area for the Shuumatsuban to keep me from sleeping there.
Ugh, but how did she find this one...

dialogue.sit: Do you think she's also the one behind the slimes we ran into earlier?

dialogue.t: I dunno, maybe not... The shrine maiden should know the danger that Pyro Slimes present to the forest.
But it's hard to say for sure... The shrine maiden will go to extreme lengths to catch me.
It's almost as if she's my sworn enemy...

dialogue.sit: She wouldn't go that far, would she?

dialogue.t: She's the bane of my existence, that's for sure.

dialogue.sit: Why don't we go and have a look at your next backup spot?

dialogue.t: Hold on, we can't just leave all these scattered around like this.
Otherwise, it could harm the kitsune or other wildlife. We should pick 'em all up.

dialogue.sit: Aren't you worried that Kano Nana could still be in the area?
If we don't leave, there's a good chance that the shrine maiden will catch us.

dialogue.t: Then we'll just have to be quick. Let's pick it all up and run. We can do it fast enough if we try.
How could the ninja leave their training equipment just sitting out here like this? Don't they know that it's dangerous?
The next time I'm at the Shuumatsuban, I'll be sure to give them a piece of my mind.

dialogue.sit: You... give them a piece of your mind?
Do you really dare?

dialogue.t: Y—Yeah, that's right. We can't just let something like this slide!
Uh, I mean... I can't promise anything, but I'll try...
Anyway, let's get a move on. We need to pick all this stuff up.

dialogue.section: Discuss your plans with Sayu again

dialogue.t: Whew... Finally. That's the last of it.
Hehe, see? Even the kitsune are thanking us now.
That's right, don't eat any strange ninja gadgets, got it?

dialogue.sit: You really love the wildlife here, don't you, Sayu?

dialogue.t: This is their home. We can't just let them get hurt here.

dialogue.sit: You're a very caring person, Sayu.

dialogue.t: Well, uh... I just wanted to help the wildlife here.
*yawn* But what should we do about getting a nap... *sigh* The shrine maiden could appear at any moment.

dialogue.sit: Perhaps we can go to your next napping spot?

dialogue.t: Given what we saw just now, I'm afraid the shrine maiden has already discovered all my usual spots. Nowhere is safe from the maiden...
In which case, we'll need to scout out a new place to nap.

dialogue.sit: How about Konda Village?

dialogue.t: No, there's too many people there. All the shrine maiden would have to do is ask around and she'd know where we are in no time.

dialogue.sit: How about Amakane Island?

dialogue.t: The scenery is nice there, but there's too much rustling and noise. It'll be hard to sleep there.

dialogue.sit: How about Tenshukaku?

dialogue.t: What made you think of Tenshukaku? You don't want to make me sleep in between the eaves, do you?
I could definitely sleep soundly in a place like that, but there won't be enough space for me to grow at all.
*sigh* I guess there's no choice but to go out adventuring... As they say, "The most dangerous of places is often the safest of places."
So if we're going to avoid the shrine maiden, I guess the safest place would be the Grand Narukami Shrine.

dialogue.sit: Huh? Are you serious?

dialogue.t: Yeah. She'd never expect to find me sleeping in the big tree at the Grand Narukami Shrine.
All we need to do is carefully make our way inside without drawing any unwanted attention.
Once we're in, I'll be able to take a nice, long, undisturbed nap.

dialogue.sit: I suppose that makes sense. Let's give it a try.

dialogue.t: Alright, up the mountain we go!

dialogue.section: Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine

dialogue.t: Huh? Forget the shrine maiden, this place is crawling with members of the Yashiro Commission. What are they all doing here?
But we can't turn back now. Let's sneak inside and have a closer look.
Don't alert them to our presence, alright? Quietly now...

dialogue.section: Talk to Sayu

dialogue.t: Whew, good thing they didn't notice us. That scary Guuji lady doesn't seem to be around either.
Actually, I've always wanted to come here for a nap. It's spacious, and... *yawn* super comfy.
I'm already... really sleepy... *yawn*

dialogue.sit: We went through a lot to get here.
Then I won't disturb you.

dialogue.t: Thanks for sticking with me. If you ever need a ninja, my skills are at your disposal.
Even though I prefer to avoid my work with the Shuumatsuban, if it's you that I'm assisting, I'm more than happy to help.
Ideally when I'm not sleepy, of course.
Sayu! Where are you, Sayu?
The shrine maiden! H—How did she find me here!?
Wh—What should I do... Oh, not good... not good!

dialogue.sit: I'll go stall her to buy you some time.

dialogue.t: Would you? Oh, thanks! Just see if you can lure her away from here!
Hmm? Oh, it's you.
After I returned from checking with the Yashiro Commission concerning the ambush operation, I discovered that you and Sayu had already left the forest.
Is she here with you?

dialogue.sit: Nope, she's not here.
She left a while ago.

dialogue.t: Strange, I found all sorts of traces along the road. They all pointed me towards this shrine.
Well, never mind. If you haven't seen her here, then perhaps she ran off to another one of her hiding spots.
I did manage to confirm that the ambush order did not originate from the Yashiro Commission. An investigation is already underway. It seems we'll have more information soon enough, you needn't worry.

dialogue.sit: Thank you, that was very kind of you. If that's all, I'll be leaving now.

dialogue.t: Hmm... Wait a moment.
Are you absolutely sure you haven't seen Sayu?

dialogue.sit: Yes, I'm sure.
Y—Yes, absolutely sure.

dialogue.t: *sigh* ...
Although I can't prove it, my intuition tells me that she is nearby.

dialogue.sit: (She's really not buying it...)
(No wonder Sayu's always looking over her shoulder...)

dialogue.t: Huh...
Strange, I don't think I've ever seen this kitsune around the Shrine before...
It seems to be concerned about the tree here... I wonder if there's something in the branches.

dialogue.sit: (Oh no, it's the kitsune from when we were picking up all the ninja gear!)
Run!!!

dialogue.t: You'll never catch me!!!

dialogue.section: Discuss your plans with Sayu

dialogue.t: *sigh* How am I supposed to nap here with slimes everywhere?

dialogue.sit: Is this where you usually come to nap?

dialogue.t: *yawn* Yep. It's not ideal for hiding, but it certainly has a nice view and tons of fresh air. Napping here makes your dreams just that much sweeter.
But slimes? Seriously, what gives? There's never any slimes here...
And now there's ashes everywhere. Ugh, I can't nap here, I'll feel all nasty and grimy and it'll make my outfit dirty.

dialogue.sit: You seem pretty picky over just a place to nap.

dialogue.t: Of course! Even though I can sleep practically anywhere, it's very important to consider the quality of my sleep.
Just in case the shrine maiden ever appears, I always sleep with one ear to the ground. That way, I can run to escape the moment I hear her approaching.
*yawn* Which is exactly why I'm such a light sleeper now.

dialogue.sit: You're always alert, aren't you...
I suppose one could say this makes you an even more impressive ninja.

dialogue.t: That's how things are during the day. But sometimes, I can't sleep well at night, either. *sigh*
I suppose the good news is that we got rid of these slimes before the whole forest went up in flames.
Seems like I'll need to scout out another place to nap.

dialogue.sit: Do you have any backup napping spots?

dialogue.t: Of course, but the shrine maiden is always looking for where I like to sleep, so I have to keep finding more.
Come with me, hopefully she hasn't discovered any of my recent napping spots.
Oh uh, they see us!

quests.description: Rather than working or training, Sayu thinks that sleeping is of the utmost urgency and importance.

quests.title: Operation Substitution

dialogue.section: Go to the ninjutsu training ground

dialogue.t: I'll show you my favorite skill to practice. Basically, it's an escape technique — I use it to make a quick getaway whenever the shrine maiden's after me.
*sigh* Alright, Sayu, just leave the explanation to me. This is a technique to help ninja train their agility.
When the unpredictable happens during a mission, ninja must be capable of traversing a variety of terrains.
During our training, we often set up obstacles on both sides of this stream and have Sayu make her way up the course.
I often slipped when I was little and either found myself falling face-first into the mud or getting battered as I tumbled down.
So don't underestimate this little course of ours, it's not as easy as you think.
Sayu may be exaggerating a little. With your adventuring experience, I'm sure you'll do fine.
Yeah, go ahead and give it a try, I'll guide you through it.
Nice try, Sayu. You'll run the course first. Quickly, now.
Aw...
Come now, no stalling. Give the Traveler a proper demonstration.
Alright, alright. Leave it to me.
Although Sayu doesn't usually exert her best effort, she does have strong ninja fundamentals.
Do your best. I'll be waiting at the finish, {NICKNAME}.
Do your best. I'll be waiting at the finish, {NICKNAME}.
Wow, impressive. You've really got some talent.
If I were to rate your performance, I'd say you're like... a strong, fast mujina.
Anyway, nicely done. I was *yawn* ...rooting for you.

dialogue.sit: Why are you talking so different all of a sudden?
You're still Sayu... aren't you?

dialogue.t: Hehe, don't mind me, I just happened to remember the words of my sensei.
After each training session, sensei would give me a score and encourage me based on my results.
I'm surprised you remember your sensei's words so clearly, Sayu, hehe. But don't you think your sensei would disapprove of you copying their words?
Hehe, no way! Sensei wouldn't be mad at all.

dialogue.sit: Where is your sensei now? Have they already left these lands?

dialogue.t: Yep, Sensei said there were some important matters to attend to.
Sensei told me that they hoped I would become a responsible ninja while they are away. You know, the kind of ninja everyone can trust.
You remember your Sensei's words, but you sure don't seem to act on them, skipping work all the time...
Hey, I work hard... when I'm not sleepy. It's just that this season is perfect for napping, I really can't help it.
*sigh* The problem is that to you, every season is perfect for napping.
Anyway, you've certainly handled the training well so far. The next exercise is live-combat training. Let's go, shall we?
Considering that you have yet to grasp the art of ninjutsu, we'll let Sayu demonstrate in combat first. And this will be a prime opportunity for you to see her ninjutsu first hand.
Sure thing, just leave it to me. Let my example illuminate your path to ninjutsu.
*sigh* There you go again, Sayu. You know, imitating what other people say is a poor habit.
S—Sorry...
You're still a way off from my personal record, but don't worry, just keep it up.
If I were to rate your performance, I'd say you're like... an average, everyday kitsune.
A kitsune is pretty good, you know...

dialogue.sit: Why are you talking so different all of a sudden?
You're still Sayu... aren't you?

dialogue.t: Hehe, don't mind me, I just happened to remember the words of my sensei.
After each training session, sensei would give me a score and encourage me based on my results.
I'm surprised you remember your sensei's words so clearly, Sayu, hehe. But don't you think your sensei would disapprove of you copying their words?
Hehe, no way! Sensei wouldn't be mad at all.

dialogue.t: Yep, Sensei said there were some important matters to attend to.

*sigh* The problem is that to you, every season is perfect for napping.
Anyway, you've certainly handled the training well so far. The next exercise is live-combat training. Let's go, shall we?
Considering that you have yet to grasp the art of ninjutsu, we'll let Sayu demonstrate in combat first. And this will be a prime opportunity for you to see her ninjutsu first hand.
Sure thing, just leave it to me. Let my example illuminate your path to ninjutsu.
*sigh* There you go again, Sayu. You know, imitating what other people say is a poor habit.
S—Sorry...
Ouch, that was... a little unfortunate.
If I were to rate your performance, I'd say you're like... a slow, arthritic turtle.
But don't let that bother you, more practice is all you need.

dialogue.sit: Why are you talking so different all of a sudden?
You're still Sayu... aren't you?

dialogue.t: Hehe, don't mind me, I just happened to remember the words of my sensei.
After each training session, sensei would give me a score and encourage me based on my results.
I'm surprised you remember your sensei's words so clearly, Sayu, hehe. But don't you think your sensei would disapprove of you copying their words?
Hehe, no way! Sensei wouldn't be mad at all.

dialogue.t: Yep, Sensei said there were some important matters to attend to.
Sensei told me that they hoped I would become a responsible ninja while they are away. You know, the kind of ninja everyone can trust.

Anyway, you've certainly handled the training well so far. The next exercise is live-combat training. Let's go, shall we?
Considering that you have yet to grasp the art of ninjutsu, we'll let Sayu demonstrate in combat first. And this will be a prime opportunity for you to see her ninjutsu first hand.
Sure thing, just leave it to me. Let my example illuminate your path to ninjutsu.
*sigh* There you go again, Sayu. You know, imitating what other people say is a poor habit.
S—Sorry...

dialogue.section: Go to the live combat training ground

dialogue.t: Here we are. Now, please carefully observe Sayu's skills in combat.
I'll do my best to make my ninjutsu a little easier to understand.

dialogue.section: Talk to Sayu

dialogue.t: Whew, I'm tired.
At least I didn't get my outfit dirty... *yawn*
So, did you pay close attention to my ninjutsu?
Here, I'll teach you. First you stretch your upper body a bit, do a little wiggle... And then turn yourself into a ball, like this...

dialogue.sit: Hold on.
No need to rush.

dialogue.t: Huh? What's the matter? You don't want to transform into a ball?
Don't worry, you might feel a little dizzy at first, but you'll get used to it.

dialogue.sit: I don't think this technique is as easy as it looks...

dialogue.t: I thought you'd be able to catch on after seeing a quick demonstration.
*yawn* Anyway, I'm beat and need a good nap now. Hopefully I won't need to demonstrate that again.

dialogue.sit: But didn't you say that you would show me the path to ninjutsu?

dialogue.t: Uh yeah, that was my sensei's teaching... Very strong and patient... which is a little too much work for me.

dialogue.sit: I'm really starting to wonder what kind of person your sensei was.

dialogue.t: Strong, responsible, and kind. Sensei never pushed me to do more work.
Uh...
Actually, after hearing myself say that, I suppose Sensei was a lot like you.
Although you don't know ninjutsu like Sensei did, your other qualities are enough to make you my sensei.

dialogue.sit: Your sensei was also a ninja? Did they go by a special name?

dialogue.t: Sure, Sensei's name was... Uh, what was it now...? Huh, I guess I never asked, I just called them "sensei."
I think Sensei was a ninja. Actually, Sensei never really mentioned it...

dialogue.sit: Okay... Well, how about some other qualities like their height?

dialogue.t: Sensei's height... Hmm, they were taller than me. As for other qualities...

dialogue.sit: It seems there was a lot you didn't know about your sensei.

dialogue.t: Sometimes it's hard to tell from just appearances... But these details don't matter to me.
Alright, that's enough idle chatter for now. If Sayu's sensei ever returns, I'm sure you'll have the chance to meet.
As for our next exercise...
Uh wait, I'm not quite up to it yet... I need to take a break first.
We agreed on a break after every two exercises, didn't we? Remember, to keep training from being too forceful...
Fine. Even if I did push you, I suppose you would end up napping on the field anyway.
Go, have a rest. I shall wait for you here. Remember, no running off.
Got it. Come with me, {NICKNAME}. I'll take you to a nice place to relax a bit.
Whew. Finally, time for a break!

dialogue.section: Follow Sayu to her resting spot

dialogue.t: Just as I thought, exactly the same as before...

dialogue.sit: What is the rope there used for?

dialogue.t: Sensei knew that I was concerned about my height, so before leaving, Sensei measured my height and used the rope to mark it on the tree over there.
"Nothing is more satisfying than growing." At least, that's what Sensei told me...
But even after all this time, not only have I yet to outgrow the rope... I think the rope is getting higher with the tree.
*sigh* Maybe it's because I'm not sleeping enough.

dialogue.sit: It's normal for trees to grow taller than people.
Trees should be taller than people.
I don't think a tree of this height will grow any taller.

dialogue.t: I get it, and that's exactly what I told Sensei at the time.
But Sensei only laughed, though they didn't scold me at all... I guess Sensei had their own way of looking at things.
I really couldn't tell what Sensei was thinking in moments like that. Do you have any idea what Sensei might have meant?

dialogue.sit: I think I have an idea, but it is just a guess.

dialogue.t: That's okay, just say it. Either way, I'm sure you understand more than me.

dialogue.sit: All trees will grow sooner or later.

dialogue.t: Grow...

dialogue.sit: All trees will bloom sooner or later.

dialogue.t: Bloom...

dialogue.sit: All trees will cast shade over someone they can protect sooner or later.

dialogue.t: Shade...
Hmm, I think I understand now.
I love to take naps under a tree, or hide in the shade, or eat some of its fruit. This is how the tree provides for me.

dialogue.sit: I believe Sensei hoped that one day you would provide for someone in the same way.

dialogue.t: I see...
Okay, just wait here. Don't worry, I'll be right back.
These fruits are for you.

dialogue.sit: I think you're taking this a little too literally.
Seems you haven't grasped the deeper meaning at all.

dialogue.t: No, no. I get it now! Uh, how should I put it...

Sometimes I think that the Shuumatsuban is more trouble than it's worth. Everyone's trying to keep me from getting enough sleep and growing taller... Sometimes I wonder why I even bother sticking around with them.
But every time I think about it, I can't help but remember Sensei's smile, and then I think of this tree, and my Vision.
Someday, this tree will also be shelter for a kitsune, or some other animal. In the same way, someday, after I've grown nice and tall, I'll be protecting someone with my ninjutsu.

dialogue.sit: Which is exactly why you should take your work more seriously.

dialogue.t: I know...*sigh* Sorry. I guess I was hoping that I'd grow faster, and then I could work hard. But it seems that I've already spent too much time trying to grow...

"If I gave up my dreams of growing tall, could I still fulfill everyone's hopes?" I've always avoided asking myself this question, it just makes me feel a little nervous... And I've yet to find an answer.
I still don't know what to do. *sigh* I don't even know what I actually can do... But, I thought that at least I can give you some fruit to eat, hehe.
You remind me of Sensei — you're kind and can even understand what Sensei was thinking.
So I thought I should at least show a little bit of enthusiasm.

dialogue.sit: You can call me "Sensei" if you like.

dialogue.t: Huh? But wasn't I the one teaching you ninjutsu just now?
Although, I'm sure you know a lot more about life than me... So I guess you could still count as my teacher in that regard.

dialogue.sit: Why don't we just relax for now. We're supposed to be taking a break, remember?

dialogue.t: Oh yeah, you're right. Hehe, I was getting a little carried away.
Why don't we go practice a little more ninjutsu after our break is up? Today is one of those rare days when I feel super motivated!
But never mind that for now, we've got lots of fruit to eat. C'mon, take whichever you like, hehe.

dialogue.section: Talk to Sayu

dialogue.t: You may go have a break with Sayu. It's important to recover your stamina and stay hydrated.

quests.description: So Sayu wanted you to learn ninjutsu so that you could replace her at work...

quests.title: Shuumatsuban Suspicions

dialogue.section: Go to the agreed place and wait for the other party

dialogue.t: Sayu, is it true? Have you completed the mission?
I don't recall you ever taking any ambush missions before. How were you able to deal with the renowned Traveler so swiftly?
Uh, well... You see, I... I caught {M#him}{F#her} off guard! Yeah, that's it, {M#he}{F#she} didn't have time to react.
All it took was one THUMP! Then BAM! And it was over...
Oh no, how could this be. I really didn't see this coming...
Don't you usually just ignore your orders from the Shuumatsuban? How was I supposed to know that you'd actually take this one and finish it so efficiently?
Uh, well, I don't feel sleepy every day, you know.
So don't underestimate me. My sensei did teach me some ambush techniques, I just never used them before, that's all.
I see... Fine, I'll report back then.
Hey, wait! Don't leave! {NICKNAME}, you can come out now!

dialogue.sit: Stop right there.
Don't even think about running off.

dialogue.t: Huh!? Explain yourself, Sayu. What's going on here? So... you were lying to me the whole time? The Traveler is still alive?

dialogue.sit: Alive and in the flesh.

dialogue.t: The shrine maiden already confirmed that there was no such mission.
So we decided to catch you red-handed in your own game, you sneaky sneak.
W—Wait, I can explain! It's not what you think!
Yes, I was the one who forged the ambush mission, but I had good reason to!

dialogue.sit: Tell us the truth, no more lies!
Save it for the Yashiro Commission. I'm sure they'd love to hear your story.

dialogue.t: Just hear me out! You see, last night, my little daughter suddenly disappeared from home. I was starting to get worried when a Kairagi appeared at my door and told me they'd taken her.
They told me I'd only see my kid again if I did exactly as they said. Their terms were for me to forge orders from the Yashiro Commission and dispatch a ninja to ambush the Traveler.
Huh? That doesn't make sense... Why would the Kairagi want to ambush the Traveler? And why the Shuumatsuban?

dialogue.sit: I fight the Kairagi on a daily basis, it only makes sense that they would seek revenge.

dialogue.t: Oh, no wonder...

dialogue.sit: Maybe they know that they're not strong enough to take me out, so they wanted to hire an expert to do the job.

dialogue.t: That seems about right. I was puzzled myself, but they didn't tell me anything... and I didn't dare to ask.
I was scared out of my wits. I simply did whatever they told me to.
Then it dawned on me that Sayu was the only ninja that never carried out such confrontational tasks, and that Kano Nana is her guardian.
So I thought that if I assigned the task to Sayu, it wouldn't be a threat to you at all. Half the time she never even completes her tasks.

To my surprise, just as I was about to secretly contact the Tenryou Commission and save my kid, I found Sayu's bag in the mission crate indicating that the job was taken care of... It scared me half to death.
No wonder you looked so unhappy when I met with you.

Of course, given the Traveler's position in the Yashiro Commission, who would dare make any move against them... After hearing Sayu carried out the task, I really felt things were spinning out of control.
To be honest, I was relieved to see that you were all right.
He seems to be telling the truth.

dialogue.sit: He did seem a bit relieved when I appeared. Now it makes sense.

dialogue.t: Are the Kairagi still holding your child hostage?
Yes, that's right. Myself and the Tenryou Commission are both at a loss as to what to do now...
If the Kairagi catch on to us, they might harm my child... *sigh* No, we mustn't let that happen, no matter what.
Seems we need to come up with a plan of our own.
What do you suggest?
Think about it this way... If I did successfully ambush the Traveler, you would still have to report it to the Kairagi.
Ah, I see. I'll use the evidence to rescue my daughter!

dialogue.sit: But there's a chance the Kairagi won't go along with it.

dialogue.t: No worries, we'll be hiding nearby, so we can act if we need to.

dialogue.sit: Sounds like a plan.

dialogue.t: Now I can put my ninjutsu to good use, heh!

dialogue.sit: Seems you've considered all the possible angles.

dialogue.t: It's a serious situation, we should all be vigilant.
Then it's decided. I'll contact the Kairagi as well as the Tenryou Commission.
My child's safety is in your hands. Please, don't let anything happen to her.
N—No, please, just hear me out! I'll explain everything!
I've got him tied up, he's not going anywhere.
That takes care of that. Now all we need to do is drag you back and I can have a good night's sleep.

dialogue.section: Go with Ogawa to meet the Kairagi

dialogue.t: It seems the Kairagi has arrived. Oh, and that must be Mr. Ogawa's daughter.
Even after they hear the news that the ambush has been completed, there's no telling whether they'd make good on their promise to Mr. Ogawa.

dialogue.sit: I have my doubts.

dialogue.t: They really have no honor, do they?

dialogue.sit: I'm sure they'll still want more.
Greed has no end.

dialogue.t: I see...
Alright, I'll stay wide awake and fully alert.

dialogue.sit: Yes, me too.

dialogue.t: Alright, you asked me to dispatch a ninja to get rid of the Traveler. Well, the deed is done. Here's some proof: {F#her}{M#his} hair and clothing.
Oh, is that so? Show me.
Hmph, seems legit. How could I forget this gaudy hair color.
Imagine, a Traveler from another land just coming here and attacking my people. That rascal should have known better.
Heh, too bad {F#she}{M#he} never had the chance to learn from {F#her}{M#his} mistakes. Haha!
Well then, I've held up my end of the deal. Now you must hold up yours, where's my child?
Oh? You really don't get it, do you?
What!?
I only said that it was over for her unless you do as I say. I never said anything about returning the little brat to you.
Daddy...
I think we've held up our terms, I even brought her here to prove it to you.
This way, I'm sure you'll be willing as ever to continue working with us.
Huh? That's not what you said!
You dare speak in such a tone with me!?
Don't let me lose my temper. Who's to say that I won't just do away with the both of you... I can do anything when I'm angry.
Or... perhaps you feel bolder now because you've already ratted on me to the Shogunate? Hmm!?
Huh? No, no, I wouldn't dare, I...
But my child... Tell me, what must I do to get my child back!
Let me think about it... And while I'm thinking, you can use these invincible ninja of yours to take out a couple pesky members of the Tenryou Commission.
Huh, how could I do that! How could anyone from the Shuumatsuban move against the Tenryou Commission!?
That's not my problem to figure out. It's yours!
Enough talking. Now, get out of here.
Argh!
Hey! You really think we'd just let you off the hook like that?
Huh!? Who are you? Ninja?
And you! Aren't you supposed to be...

dialogue.sit: Getting rid of me isn't that easy.
I'm the outlander, Traveler of countless worlds!

dialogue.t: Ugh! Brothers, get them!
Ugh, Ogawa! This isn't over, you'll pay for this. You haven't seen the last of me!

dialogue.section: Talk to Sayu

dialogue.t: Hehe, not another step closer, Traveler. I'm warning you.
You certainly live up to your reputation, there's no doubt about that... But remember, the little girl is still in my hands.
Best not to do anything too hasty, we wouldn't want anything to happen to her, would we now?
Hehe, don't test me now, I'll... Wait, huh...!?

dialogue.sit: It's not afraid of your blade.
Go ahead, do it.

dialogue.t: H—How did this happen? When did you...
You've heard how skilled the ninja of the Shuumatsuban are, haven't you? Heh, too easy!
So easy that... *yawn* I'm starting to feel a little bit sleepy.
Huh? You little brat, you dare mock me? I'll pulverize you!
Stop right there!
This is the suspect behind the incident you reported?
Yes, that's right! Kotomi is already safe. Quick, you must apprehend him immediately!
Argh!
Daddy!
*sobs* I knew that you would come to rescue me!
Don't cry, my dear. Daddy's here. Everything's all right now.
Come now, you should thank these two. Without them, we would have never been able to rescue you.
Thank you, {F#Ms. Traveler}{M#Mr. Traveler}! You and Ms. Ninja saved me!
Ms. Ninja...
Hehe, don't mention it. It's nothing for a ninja.

dialogue.sit: I'm just glad you're okay.

dialogue.t: Such agility, and the way you handled that blade... I must say that I am quite impressed.
As for Sayu, I had thought that you'd given up on your ninja training. But somehow you seem to be stronger than ever.
If you don't mind, I'll be taking my child home now. Her mother has been worried sick.
Thank you, all of you. I could never repay you.

dialogue.sit: You're most welcome.
I'm glad we could help.

dialogue.t: Please take care, the road is still dangerous.
Thank you {F#Ms. Traveler and Ms. Ninja!}{M#Mr. Traveler and Ms. Ninja!}
Hey, please wait a second. There's something I've been meaning to tell you.
This isn't the first time the Kairagi have done something like this. With a little further investigation, I think we could track down the bigger fish.

dialogue.sit: You seem to have changed, Sayu. So hard working now...
But don't you feel sleepy?

dialogue.t: Well, to be honest, I couldn't care less at first. All that ambushing stuff was just getting in the way of my nap schedule...
But after witnessing the crying kid and that big, nasty bad guy, I couldn't just ignore the situation like usual.
At that moment, the situation felt a lot more personal... Like it was my own problem, too.
In the end, the little girl thanked us, and even called me Ms. Ninja... No one has ever called me that before.

dialogue.sit: Who knows, Sayu... Maybe you're a really hard worker after all.

dialogue.t: Hmm, don't count on it... This time just was an exception. Sleeping is still what I do best.
In fact, once this is all over with, I'm going to find a nice, comfy spot where nobody can find me and take a long nap.
Yes... A really long... Comfy... *yawn*
Whew, I'm getting sleepy...

dialogue.sit: Let's all take a rest then, shall we?

dialogue.t: No need, let's head back first. If I fall asleep now, I'm worried that I might forget some of the things that happened today...
So don't worry about me... I'll be just... fine... *dozing off*

dialogue.section: Bring Ogawa to the Yashiro Commission for a confrontation

dialogue.t: Hm? Oh, hello Traveler. And I see Sayu and Mr. Ogawa are with you. Is something the matter?
I understand the situation... It seems Mr. Ogawa was only acting out of coercion from the Kairagi, he had no intent to truly harm you.
However, it concerns me that those forged orders went as far as they did, it's my responsibility to look into such matters. I will take the appropriate measures to resolve this.

dialogue.sit: No problem.
As long as we can resolve the situation.

dialogue.t: Allow me to take the investigation matters from here. You needn't worry any longer.
*yawn* If that's all, then we should get going.
I can't help but feel a little uneasy here...
It's not often that I get to see you here, Sayu.
Uh... Heh.
It seems that Sayu is almost always sleepy and in need of a good nap. To see her here accompanying you and addressing these matters goes to show how much effort she is expending on your behalf.
But from now on, you should better attend to your duties. There's no need to keep Kano Nana worrying all the time.
But I don't want to work...
All I want is some sleep, but you keep the shrine maiden on my tail all the time.
There's loads of way more qualified ninja to handle every task. The Shuumatsuban would be the same with or without me.
But you performed admirably the first time you assisted the Traveler, did you not?
Everyone believes that there are some missions that only you can accomplish.
This truth remains, whether you choose to believe it or not. Your sensei taught you ninjutsu so that you may step in when a mission needs you.
Yes, I understand, but...
Sorry, I don't know what to say.
I should go... bye.
*sigh* ...

dialogue.sit: Perhaps you were a little too hard on her?

dialogue.t: She's just a little... lost. It is only my wish to help her.
Before her sensei suddenly decided to leave, they insisted that I watch over her progress. Part of the reason I've assigned Kano Nana to keep an eye on her is to fulfill my promise.
In fact, I'm certain that Sayu remembers her sensei's aspirations for her quite clearly. Otherwise, she would have quit the Shuumatsuban long ago.
She's been lost and unsure of herself ever since her beloved sensei's abrupt departure.

dialogue.sit: I understand. I'll go see if I can talk to her.

dialogue.t: Thank you, Traveler. She obviously has some reservations towards me. Though I've only desired to help and look after her, I'm afraid it's never culminated to much.

dialogue.sit: This is what we call "growing pains."

dialogue.t: Yes, perhaps you're right.

dialogue.section: Comfort the confused Sayu

dialogue.t: Sensei told me that all I need to do is grow big and tall. I remember that...
I had no idea how difficult such a simple thing could turn out to be.
I'm not complaining, you know. I understand everyone has hopes for me... Miss Kamisato, Sensei, the shrine maiden...
But I haven't done anything right. And whenever I try to do my best, I can't help but feel more pressure bearing down on me.
If only I grew a little taller, maybe then I could handle it.

dialogue.sit: Don't worry Sayu. Like Ayaka said, no one wants to pressure you.

dialogue.t: *sigh* I guess all I can do is say sorry...

dialogue.sit: If you don't try now, there's no guarantee that you can do well in the future.

dialogue.t: I get it. That's why I admire those who still try... even if they don't want to.

dialogue.sit: Maybe you won't grow right away, but I can lift you higher whenever needed.

dialogue.t: But, what would I do if I keep you from growing? No, I would feel too guilty...
Anyway, thank you. I don't know what else to say. Even talking is starting to feel difficult now.
This is why I don't like coming here...
Please, go and talk to her. See if you can offer her any console.
I understand the trouble she is facing. Fortunately, she is young and has many years ahead of her. There's no need to be hasty.

quests.description: You decide to investigate the Shuumatsuban personally. You and Sayu decide to lure the person who gave the order out...
